example.en: The corporate convention center is conveniently situated directly opposite the main metro station.
example.zh: 這座商務會議展覽中心位置便利，就正正座落於中央捷運火車站的斜對面。

words.mnemonic: op- (相反、朝向) + posit (放置) ＝ 放在正對面的 ＝ directly opposite (正對面)。

example.en: Achieving profitability this fiscal quarter represents a major milestone for our software startup.
example.zh: 在本會計季度實現轉虧為盈，對我們的軟體新創公司而言是一座重大的里程碑。

words.mnemonic: 專案進度管理核心字彙：milestone (專案里程碑重要階段)。

example.en: The company invested a substantial sum of money into developing autonomous delivery vehicle prototypes.
example.zh: 該公司投入了一筆可觀的巨額資金，用於研發自動駕駛物流車的原型車輛。

words.mnemonic: 財務必備：lump sum (一次性整筆支付金額)、sum up (總結會議要點)。

example.en: Rush-hour highway traffic during the evening downtown commute can be absolute murder.
example.zh: 在晚間市中心通勤的交通尖峰時段，高速公路塞車簡直讓人痛苦難耐折騰萬分。

words.mnemonic: 多益聽力日常誇飾用語：Rush-hour traffic is murder (尖峰塞車簡直是折磨)。

meaning: 電腦螢幕/監控儀器(名詞)

example.en: Quality control software engineers continuously monitor server performance to prevent outages.
example.zh: 品管軟體工程師隨時持續監控伺服器主機效能，以防止系統意外當機停擺。

words.mnemonic: monit- (警告、提醒) + -or ＝ 提醒注意狀態的人或儀器 ＝ 監視、電腦螢幕。

example.en: Despite severe logistical disruptions, the warehouse distribution team decided to soldier on.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的物流配送中斷阻礙，倉儲發貨團隊依然決定堅定奮戰克服困難。

words.mnemonic: 商業職場勵志片語：soldier on (不屈不撓堅定奮戰前行)。

example.en: The corporate commercial bank agreed to finance the construction of the new production plant.
example.zh: 該企業商業銀行同意為這座全新工廠的興建工程提供融資借貸資金支援。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業核心：finance department (財務部)、financial statement (財務報表)。

example.en: I hate to bother you during your annual leave, but we urgently need your client file password.
example.zh: 我實在很不願意在您的年休假期期間打擾您，但我們緊急需要您負責的客戶檔案密碼。

words.mnemonic: 職場客套委婉用語：I hate to bother you, but... (很過意不去打擾您，但是...)。

example.en: Analysts predict that sales will rise next quarter.
example.zh: 分析師預測下一季銷售額將上升。

words.mnemonic: pre-（預先）+ dict（說）＝事先說出來。

example.en: The new system is more efficient.
example.zh: 電子公文系統是管理日常行政作業非常高效的方式。

words.mnemonic: 少花時間或資源。

example.en: Staff distributed the forms to visitors.
example.zh: 會議開始前，秘書向所有與會代表分發了議程表。

words.mnemonic: 把東西分給多人。
roots: tribut 給予 → 分給大家

example.en: The museum will exhibit local artwork.
example.zh: 我們公司將在下週的科技展覽會上展出新款機器人。

words.mnemonic: exhibit artwork。
roots: hibit 握住 → 拿出來展示

example.en: Since the senior project manager was out of the office, her deputy led the client consultation.
example.zh: 由於資深專案經理不在辦公室，由她的代理人主持客戶諮詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考法：表時間「自從」（搭配現在完成式）或表原因「既然/因為」。

example.en: Our marketing division plans to run a promotional campaign on popular social media platforms.
example.zh: 我們的行銷部門計劃在熱門社群媒體平台上推行一場宣傳促銷活動。

words.mnemonic: 多益常考「經營管理/執行活動」：run a business (做生意), run a campaign。

example.en: The historical office complex is currently under renovation to improve accessibility for all visitors.
example.zh: 這座歷史悠久的辦公園區目前正在整修中，以提升所有訪客的無障礙便利性。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻片語結構：under construction (施工中)、under warranty (在保固期內)。

example.en: Employees must remember to turn off all air conditioning units and office lights before leaving.
example.zh: 員工在離開辦公室前務必記得關閉所有冷氣機與辦公室照明。

words.mnemonic: 關閉與繳交設備動詞片語：turn off (關閉電源)、turn in (呈繳報告)。

example.en: Only a few tickets remain available for the annual charity banquet this weekend.
example.zh: 本週末舉行的年度慈善晚宴目前僅剩為數不多的票券可供購買。

words.mnemonic: 修飾可數複數名詞：a few (少數幾個/一些)；few (幾乎沒有)。

example.en: All workshop attendees should bring their employee identification badges to access the building.
example.zh: 所有工作坊與會者皆應攜帶其員工識別證以進入大樓。

words.mnemonic: 商務會談常客：bring about (促成)、bring up (在會議中提出討論)。

example.en: Passengers who take advantage of our early booking discount can save up to thirty percent.
example.zh: 善用我們早鳥預訂優惠的旅客最多可節省百分之三十的費用。

words.mnemonic: 多益促銷經典用法：early bird discount (早鳥優惠)。

example.en: Please hand in your finalized expense reimbursement forms to the accounting department by noon.
example.zh: 請於中午前將填寫完畢的差旅報銷單交至會計部門。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室交公文必備片語：hand in (繳交)、hand out (發放講義)。

example.en: The corporate contract clearly states that all cancellation requests must be submitted in writing.
example.zh: 企業合約中明確陳述所有取消申請皆必須以書面方式提出。

words.mnemonic: 正式文件陳述條款動詞；名詞 state of the art (最先進的技術)。

example.en: Our regional marketing headquarters will move to a newly constructed office park next month.
example.zh: 我們的區域行銷總部將於下個月搬遷至新建成的辦公園區。

words.mnemonic: 辦公室搬遷公告考點：move to a new location (搬遷至新址)。

example.en: We offer a thirty-day money-back guarantee if customers are not completely satisfied with the product.
example.zh: 若客戶對產品不甚滿意，我們提供三十天內無條件全額退費保證。

words.mnemonic: 客戶退款保證標準詞彙：money-back guarantee (不滿意退費保證)。

example.en: The consultant presented verified facts and figures to support the corporate restructuring proposal.
example.zh: 顧問提出了經過查證的事實與數據，以支持企業組織重整的提案。

words.mnemonic: 會議提案用片語：facts and figures (事實與數據)、in fact (事實上)。

example.en: We intended to dispatch the shipment today; however, severe weather forced a temporary delay.
example.zh: 我們原定今日發貨；然而，惡劣天候迫使出貨暫時延後。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀轉折語氣之王，標誌著條件受限或狀況生變。

example.en: Unauthorized personnel are strictly prohibited from entering the chemical storage area.
example.zh: 未經授權人員嚴禁進入化學品儲存區域。

words.mnemonic: 工廠安全區域標誌：restricted area (管制區)、smoking area (吸菸區)。

example.en: Please print your full legal name clearly on the conference registration badge.
example.zh: 請在研討會報到識別證上清晰正楷填寫您的法定全名。

words.mnemonic: 填表必備欄位：full name (全名)；brand name (品牌名稱)。

example.en: Employees should carefully read the revised travel reimbursement policy before booking tickets.
example.zh: 員工在訂票前應仔細審閱修訂後的差旅費報銷規定。

words.mnemonic: 簽約或實施政策常客：read carefully (仔細閱讀)。

example.en: Our current staff referral program offers cash incentives when you recommend a friend for an open position.
example.zh: 我們的內部員工推薦計畫在您推薦朋友應徵職缺成功時提供現金獎勵。

words.mnemonic: 企業招募方案常用：refer a friend (推薦朋友求職)。

example.en: Utility invoices and office rental payments are due on the first day of each month.
example.zh: 水電費帳單與辦公室租金於每個月的第一天到期應付。

words.mnemonic: 財務出帳周期：end of the month (月底)、last month (上個月)。

example.en: The newly opened regional distribution hub can store a large inventory of consumer electronics.
example.zh: 新啟用的區域經銷物流中心可存放大量的消費性電子產品庫存。

words.mnemonic: 描述規模常用：large quantity (大量)、at large (普遍地/整體而言)。

example.en: The regional sales manager will travel to London on business for three consecutive days.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理將前往倫敦連續出差三天處理公務。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的字首之一：on business (出差)、business hours (營業時間)。

example.en: Refunds cannot be issued for returned merchandise without an original store receipt.
example.zh: 退換商品若未檢附原始店家收據，恕無法辦理退款。

words.mnemonic: 政策限制常見介系詞：without prior notice (恕不另行通知)。

example.en: For more detailed information regarding hotel amenities, please inquire at the front desk.
example.zh: 欲了解更多關於飯店休閒設施的詳細資訊，請向接待櫃檯洽詢。

words.mnemonic: 多益不可數名詞大考點：for more information (如需更多資訊)。

example.en: Our downtown branch will officially open for business next Monday at eight-thirty.
example.zh: 我們的市中心分行將於下週一上午八點半正式開門營業。

words.mnemonic: 開店與職缺核心詞：open for business (營業)、job opening (職缺)。

example.en: Please include your confirmed order number when contacting customer service regarding delivery.
example.zh: 就配送問題與客戶服務部聯繫時，請隨附您的確認訂單編號。

words.mnemonic: 商業採購核心考點：place an order (下訂單)、out of order (故障)。

example.en: The engineering corporation won a lucrative contract to build government infrastructure facilities.
example.zh: 這家工程公司贏得了一項興建政府公共基礎設施的巨額標案。

words.mnemonic: 公家機關與投標常考：government regulation (政府規章)。

example.en: Positive word of mouth from satisfied customers helped our new product gain market traction quickly.
example.zh: 滿意顧客良好的口耳相傳，幫助我們的新產品迅速在市場上建立聲勢。

words.mnemonic: 行銷高頻必考片語：word of mouth (口碑行銷)。

example.en: Please report any technical issue.
example.zh: 請回報任何技術問題。

words.mnemonic: issue 可表示問題或發布。

example.en: Conducting thorough market research is crucial prior to launching products overseas.
example.zh: 在向海外推出產品之前，進行徹底的市場調查至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 商管必背字：market share (市場占有率)、market research (市調)。

example.en: We will have an important staff meeting in the main conference room at two o'clock.
example.zh: 我們將於下午兩點在主會議室召開一場重要的全體員工會議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 基礎商務動詞，常與 meeting (開會)、experience (具備經驗) 搭配。

example.en: Our marketing team will do everything possible to meet the project deadline.
example.zh: 我們的行銷團隊將竭盡全力在專案截止日前完成。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場行動必備動詞，常搭配 business (洽商) 或 research (做市調)。

example.en: The financial director said that our quarterly revenue increased significantly.
example.zh: 財務總監表示我們本季度的營收顯著成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 轉述發言或主管報告重點的關鍵動詞，常接 that 子句。

example.en: The regional sales manager will go to Chicago on business next Monday.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理將於下週一前往芝加哥出差。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 出差與行程常客，go on business 意指公務出差。

example.en: All employees must wear their identification badges inside the building.
example.zh: 所有員工在大樓內部皆必須配戴身分識別證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益公告常見字，搭配複數名詞指全員，如 all staff 或 all employees。

example.en: Ms. Clark is one of the most qualified candidates for the managerial opening.
example.zh: 克拉克女士是該主管職缺中最具資格的應徵者之一。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀與聽力極高頻句型：one of the + 複數名詞 (其中之一)。

example.en: The department head answered several questions about the proposed annual budget.
example.zh: 部門主管回答了數個關於擬定之年度預算的問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議討論主題必備介系詞，或用於數字前表示約略數額。

example.en: Please let us know if you need to modify your flight reservation.
example.zh: 若您需要修改航班預訂，請儘速告知我們。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信最標準客套句型：Please let me know / let us know。

example.en: For more information regarding the product launch, please contact our support center.
example.zh: 如需更多有關產品發布的資訊，請聯絡我們的客服支援中心。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公告、廣告文宣末尾固定句型：For more information (如需更多資訊)。

example.en: Customers who place an order before noon will get a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 中午前下單的顧客將可享有九折優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業情境指取得核准 (get approval) 或享有折扣 (get a discount)。

example.en: Our courier service offers premium options like overnight delivery and signature confirmation.
example.zh: 我們的快遞服務提供諸如隔夜送達與簽收確認等尊榮選項。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 舉例說明服務或產品特色常用的介系詞，意為如同、例如。

example.en: The board members think that opening a branch in Tokyo will boost international sales.
example.zh: 董事會成員認為在東京設立分公司將有助於推動國際銷售。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議中表達商業看法或評估方案的核心動詞。

example.en: You can make a hotel reservation directly through our corporate travel portal.
example.zh: 您可以直接透過我們的企業差旅平台預訂飯店。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 高頻搭配動詞：make a reservation (預約)、make a decision (做決策)。

example.en: The flight from London arrived on time despite unfavorable weather conditions.
example.zh: 儘管天候不佳，自倫敦起飛的班機仍準時抵達。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通與會議考點：on time (準時)、in time (及時)。

example.en: Please see the attached PDF for a detailed overview of the conference schedule.
example.zh: 請查閱附件 PDF 以取得會議時程的詳細概述。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信高頻句型：Please see the attached document (請參閱附件)。

example.en: Our total online revenue was up fifteen percent in the second quarter.
example.zh: 我們第二季度的線上總營收成長了百分之十五。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報與業績常用 up 表增長，亦常搭配 set up (架設) 或 sign up (報名)。

example.en: We need to order some replacement toner cartridges for the office printers.
example.zh: 我們需要為辦公室印表機訂購一些備用碳粉匣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購與庫存對話中常用的數量限定詞，指某些或若干用品。

example.en: The manager spoke with two other applicants before reaching a final hiring decision.
example.zh: 經理在做出最終錄取決定之前，與另外兩位應徵者進行了晤談。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務對比或篩選人選常用的形容詞，常與 applicants 或 options 搭配。

example.en: The popular office chair is temporarily out of stock due to high customer demand.
example.zh: 由於顧客需求量大，這款熱門辦公椅目前暫時缺貨。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商務必考片語：out of stock (缺貨)、out of office (休假/不在辦公室)。

example.en: Maintaining good communication with our suppliers is vital for supply chain stability.
example.zh: 與供應商保持良好溝通對於供應鏈的穩定至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 評價服務品質或產品狀況常用的基礎形容詞。

example.en: Our human resources division seeks creative people with solid analytical skills.
example.zh: 我們的人力資源部門正在尋找具備扎實分析能力的創新型人才。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 代表全體同仁或求職者的人才稱呼，商務中指具備專業能力的人才。

example.en: The corporate profit margin improved considerably over the past fiscal year.
example.zh: 在過去這一個會計年度中，企業的利潤率有了顯著提升。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務報表與績效回顧核心詞：fiscal year 代表會計年度。

example.en: Management must take immediate action to address workplace safety concerns.
example.zh: 管理層必須立即採取行動以解決職場安全疑慮。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益常考搭配：take action (採取行動)、take advantage of (善用)。

example.en: The product presentation went very well and received enthusiastic applause from investors.
example.zh: 產品發表會進行得非常順利，並獲得投資人熱烈的掌聲。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 評估專案或表現常用的副詞，片語 as well as (以及) 多益極常見。

example.en: The express shipment arrived late because the transport flight was grounded by fog.
example.zh: 快捷貨件延遲送達，是因為運輸班機受到濃霧影響而停飛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 說明業務延誤、退貨或取消原因的標準連接詞。

example.en: The corporate client was very satisfied with our comprehensive technical support.
example.zh: 該企業客戶對我們全面的技術支援服務感到非常滿意。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 加強形容詞語氣的程度副詞，常用於客戶滿意度調查。

example.en: The keynote speaker just finished setting up the projector for the presentation.
example.zh: 主講嘉賓剛剛為簡報架設好了投影機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聽力 Part 1/2 常考時態提示詞，表剛剛完成或正好及時 (just in time)。

example.en: Every brand new commercial copier comes with an all-inclusive two-year warranty.
example.zh: 每台全新商用影印機皆附帶為期兩年的全包式保固。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 產品規格與購買條件必備句型：come with (隨附/附帶)。

example.en: He will work closely with the design team to develop our new brand logo.
example.zh: 他將與設計團隊緊密合作以開發我們的新品牌商標。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場核心動詞，搭配 work on (致力於)、work closely with (密切合作)。

example.en: Authorized technicians must use protective gear when operating the heavy machinery.
example.zh: 合格技術人員在操作重型機具時必須穿戴防護裝備。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 操作設備與落實政策常見動詞，片語 make use of 意為善加利用。

example.en: Early bird tickets for the international trade summit are now available online.
example.zh: 國際貿易峰會的早鳥票現在已可於線上購買。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 活動公告高頻副詞，提示當前狀態或促銷開放時機。

example.en: Please enter your employee credentials and then click the verification button.
example.zh: 請輸入您的員工憑證，然後點擊驗證按鈕。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工作流程步驟指南（SOP）中標示前後順序的連接詞。

example.en: The corporate retreat package covers lodging and also includes complimentary meals.
example.zh: 企業研討營套裝方案涵蓋住宿，並且包含免費餐點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 合約與宣傳文案補充福利常用的副詞，常配合 not only... but also。

example.en: The software enterprise plans to expand into emerging Southeast Asian markets.
example.zh: 這家軟體企業計劃拓展進入新興的東南亞市場。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業擴張考點：expand into (打入市場) 或 look into (調查)。

example.en: This special corporate parking rate is available only to permanent staff members.

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + face (面) ＝ 最上面那一層 ＝ 表面 (surface mail 地面陸運)。

example.en: Employees can access the corporate digital training video library through the internal intranet.
example.zh: 全體員工可透過企業內部網路隨時查閱公司的數位培訓影音資源庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: libr- (書本) + -ary (場所) ＝ 圖書室，商務上常指數位資料檔案庫 (digital library)。

example.en: The newly recruited marketing specialist demonstrated an excellent command of corporate public relations.
example.zh: 新招募的行銷專員展現了對企業公共關係處理的極其出色的掌控能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cel (超越) + -ent ＝ 出類拔萃的 ＝ 優秀的 (excellent service)。

example.en: Proprietary automated manufacturing processes give our firm a distinct competitive edge.
example.zh: 專利的自動化製造工藝為我們公司帶來了顯著的市場競爭優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：competitive edge (競爭優勢)、have an edge over (勝過)。

example.en: New technical recruits attend an intensive two-week software engineering training boot camp.
example.zh: 新進技術人員需參加為期兩週的密集軟體工程培訓訓練營。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工職前培訓常見搭配：training camp / boot camp (培訓訓練營)。

example.en: The commercial marketing presentation was tailored specifically to appeal to our target corporate audience.
example.zh: 這場商務行銷簡報經過專門量身規劃，以精準吸引我們的企業目標受眾族群。

reviewWords.mnemonic: audi- (聽) + -ence (名詞) ＝ 聆聽的受眾群 ＝ 聽眾、目標受眾 (target audience)。

example.en: The regulatory commerce committee officially voted to lift export trade restrictions on semiconductors.
example.zh: 商務監管委員會正式投票通過解除對半導體產品的出口貿易限制。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：lift restrictions (解除限制禁令) 或英式電梯 (take the lift)。

example.en: Please send a confirmation email with the signed non-disclosure agreement attached.
example.zh: 請發送一封隨附已簽署保密合約的確認電子郵件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: e (electronic) + mail ＝ 電子郵件 (confirmation email)。

example.en: Our international enterprise logistics network serves global corporate clients across five continents.
example.zh: 我們的跨國企業物流網路為橫跨五大洲的全球企業客戶提供優質服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: globe (地球) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 全球性的 (global economy / market)。

example.en: Small retail shops often struggle to compete against large multinational discount e-commerce chains.
example.zh: 小型零售門市在與大型跨國平價電子商務連鎖集團競爭時往往苦苦苦苦支撐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業困境常用：struggle to compete (艱困競爭)、struggle to survive (掙扎求存)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department will advertise the vacant engineering position online.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部將在網路上刊登招聘該出缺工程師職位的公開徵才廣告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + vert (轉向) ＝ 把大眾注意力轉移過來 ＝ 登廣告 (advertise a position)。

example.en: There is little doubt that the proposed budget reductions will impact marketing activities.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，擬定之預算縮減將會對行銷推廣活動產生影響。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀常見修飾不可數名詞表否定 (little doubt 毫無疑問)；a little 表少量。

example.en: Our technical support hotline is open twenty-four hours a day to help registered users.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援專線全天候二十四小時開放，隨時為註冊用戶提供協助。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服宗旨用語：help someone with something (協助某人某事)；help desk (諮詢台)。

example.en: Attendees are warmly encouraged to ask questions at the conclusion of the workshop.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎與會人員在工作坊結束時踴躍提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 問答環節必備動詞：ask questions (提問)；ask for approval (請求核准)。

example.en: Our latest batch of electronic components meets all strict industrial quality standards.
example.zh: 我們最新一批電子零組件符合所有嚴格的工業品質標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最經典考點！meet 除了見面，更常考「符合/滿足」：meet standards, meet deadlines。

example.en: The orientation program for newly recruited employees will start promptly at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 新進員工到職培訓計畫將於上午九點整準時開始。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議、專案或機具啟動的核心動詞：start a project (啟動專案)。

example.en: The human resources manager arranged a session to talk about employee benefits and healthcare.
example.zh: 人力資源經理安排了一場說明會，以討論員工福利與健保制度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商談必備動詞：talk about (討論某事)、talk with (與某人交談)。

example.en: If you notice something wrong with your online billing statement, notify customer service at once.
example.zh: 若您發現線上對帳單有任何異常之處，請立即通知客戶服務部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶問題反饋常用句型：something wrong (有異常/出問題)。

example.en: Management decided to put together a special committee to oversee the office relocation.
example.zh: 管理層決定籌組一個專責委員會來督導辦公室搬遷事宜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務片語高頻考點：put together (組建/彙整)、put off (延期)。

example.en: In keeping with company tradition, the annual bonus announcements were made before the holidays.
example.zh: 依照公司的優良優勢傳統慣例，年終獎金的名額公布均在假期來臨前底定發布。

reviewWords.mnemonic: tra- (跨越、交付) + dit (給予) + -ion ＝ 代代相傳之事 ＝ 傳統慣例。

example.en: Retail customers who pay in cash are eligible for an immediate five percent store discount.
example.zh: 使用現金付款的零售門市顧客，即可享有立折百分之五的即時門市優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務高頻：cash flow (現金流)、cash on delivery (貨到付款 COD)。

example.en: There was hardly any difference between the two competing supplier bids in terms of price.
example.zh: 在價格報價方面，這兩家競標供應商的競標條件之間幾乎沒有任何顯著差異。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 否定副詞，多益倒裝句或文法考點：hardly any (幾乎沒有任何...)。

example.en: The municipal authority officially awarded the subway construction contract to our firm.
example.zh: 市政府主管當局已正式將該項地鐵工程興建合約授予頒標給我們公司。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重核心義：award ceremony (頒獎典禮) 或 award a contract (授予合約)。

example.en: Corporate travel policies require all non-executive personnel to book flight coach class.
example.zh: 企業差旅報銷政策規定，所有非高階主管同仁出差均必須預訂機票經濟艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票艙等必考：coach class (經濟艙)；人資 executive coach (企業高階主管教練)。

example.en: The advertising team will experiment with personalized mobile app marketing notifications.
example.zh: 廣告行銷團隊將嘗試採用個人化手機應用程式推播通知進行行銷試驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + peri (嘗試、經歷) + -ment ＝ 實地嘗試 ＝ 實驗、嘗試新策略。

example.en: Environmental impact sustainability was a primary consideration during factory site selection.
example.zh: 在工廠新廠址選址過程中，環境影響與永續性是一項最首要的考量因素。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 片語：take into consideration (將...納入考慮)；under consideration (正在研議中)。

example.en: The plant operator halted the conveyor belt after noticing a strange clicking sound.
example.zh: 廠區作業員在注意到輸送帶發出異常的喀噠異音之後，立即將其緊急停機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 設備異常回報常見：strange noise (異常噪音)、strange smell (異常氣味)。

example.en: All employees must review and sign the corporate ethical code of conduct annually.
example.zh: 全體同仁每年均必須仔細研讀並簽名同意遵守企業商業道德行為守則。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：code of conduct (行為守則) 或 promo code (促銷優惠代碼)。

meaning: 無論如何(用於加強語氣)

example.en: We will deliver the replacement equipment parts as quickly as humanly and possibly can.
example.zh: 我們將在人力所能及的前提下，以最快的速度將替換設備零件送達。

reviewWords.mnemonic: possible (可能的) + -ly (副詞尾)；as soon as possibly can。

example.en: Phishing emails and ransomware pose a severe cybersecurity threat to corporate financial databases.
example.zh: 網路釣魚信件與勒索軟體對企業金融資料庫構成了嚴峻的網路資安威脅。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 資安與商務競爭必備：cyber threat (資安威脅)、pose a threat to (對...構成威脅)。

example.en: The manufacturing plant celebrated one thousand consecutive work days without a lost-time accident.
example.zh: 該製造廠隆重慶祝了創下連續一千個工作天無人員工時損失之工安事故紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 工安常用搭配：workplace accident (職場工安意外)、by accident (偶然、意外地)。

example.en: Without additional temporary staff, completing the audit by Friday will be nearly impossible.
example.zh: 如果沒有額外增派臨時支援人力，要在本週五前完成這項審計作業將幾乎是不可能的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: im- (不) + possible (可能的) ＝ 辦不到的 (nearly impossible)。

example.en: Automated cloud enterprise software enables global distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly in real time.
example.zh: 自動化雲端企業軟體使全球各地的分散式團隊能夠即時流暢地進行協同合作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: en- (使...) + able (能夠) ＝ 使之具備能力 ＝ enable someone to do。

example.en: I am afraid that today's express courier pickup cutoff time has already passed.
example.zh: 恐怕今天的快遞專件截單收件時間已經截止過去了。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服禮貌委婉告知壞消息極高頻句型：I am afraid that... (我恐怕.../很抱歉...)。

example.en: Our mobile application has surpassed ten million monthly active consumer users.
example.zh: 我們的手機應用程式每月活躍消費者用戶數已正式突破一千萬大關。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 網路行銷與人資考核核心指標：active users (活躍用戶)、take an active role (積極參與)。

example.en: Representatives from both multinational corporations hope to conclude negotiations by tomorrow afternoon.
example.zh: 兩家跨國企業的商務協商代表均期盼能在明天下午前順利圓滿締結談判合約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (完全) + clud (關閉) ＝ 完全收尾定案 ＝ 締結合約 (conclude an agreement)。

example.en: The corporate catering menu accommodates specific dietary preferences based on medical or religious reasons.
example.zh: 企業宴會餐飲菜單可充分配合基於醫療考量或宗教信仰的特定飲食偏好需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店款待與餐飲需求必考情境：religious reasons (宗教因素飲食習慣)。

example.en: The executive employee healthcare plan covers comprehensive annual preventative cancer screenings.
example.zh: 這套高階員工醫療照護保障計畫涵蓋了每年一次的全方位預防性癌症篩檢檢查。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工健檢福利考點：cancer screening (癌症篩檢)、cancer treatment。

example.en: The sales director presented compelling market data to convince clients of our product reliability.
example.zh: 業務總監提出了極具說服力的市場數據，以使客戶完全信服我們產品的卓越可靠度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (完全) + vinc (征服、戰勝) ＝ 在心理上徹底折服對方 ＝ 說服 (convince of)。

example.en: Freight delivery transit delivery times may vary significantly depending on international customs clearance.
example.zh: 貨運運送所需的抵達時間可能會因各國海關清關速度不同而有大幅差異。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益產品與服務條款極核心句型：vary depending on (隨...而有所變動)。

example.en: Our modern factory plant complies strictly with international ISO environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 我們的新式廠房完全嚴格遵守國際 ISO 環境保護安全認證標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ESG 與企業責任核心：environmental protection (環境保護)、environmental impact。

example.en: The corporate headquarters installed rooftop solar panels to harness energy from the sun.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓屋頂加裝了太陽能板，以充分汲取來自太陽光的再生能源。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 綠能發電常考：solar power (太陽能發電)；sun deck (日照甲板/泳池露台)。

example.en: Despite global inflation pressures, our enterprise maintains a very healthy financial balance sheet.
example.zh: 儘管面臨全球通膨壓力，我們企業依然維持著非常健全穩健的財務資產負債表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：healthy lifestyle (健康生活) 或 healthy profit (健全豐厚的利潤)。

example.en: The unexpected cancellation of the municipal contract dealt a severe financial blow to the builder.
example.zh: 市政合約的意外遭到取消，對該工程建商造成了極其沉重的財務打擊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業財經常見搭配：deal a severe blow to (對...造成嚴重沉重打擊)。

example.en: The technology venture plans to invest twenty million dollars into artificial intelligence software research.
example.zh: 該科技創投公司計劃挹注投資兩千萬美元於人工智慧軟體的研發上。

reviewWords.mnemonic: in- (進入) + vest (穿上衣服、賦予職務) ＝ 資金投入進去 ＝ invest in (投資於)。

example.en: Passengers holding valid boarding passes should proceed immediately to gate forty-five.
example.zh: 持有有效登機證的旅客請立即前往四十五號登機門候機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + ceed (走) ＝ 向前行進 ＝ proceed with (繼續辦理)；proceeds (活動收益款)。

example.en: Hotel housekeeping staff wash all bed linens and bath towels using high-temperature sanitation cycles.
example.zh: 飯店房務人員使用高溫消毒程序清洗所有床單被套與浴巾。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 房務與清潔規定：wash and iron (洗熨服務)、car wash (洗車)。

example.en: Our marketing advertising firm hired an acclaimed television actor for the commercial campaign.
example.zh: 我們的廣告行銷公司聘請了一位備受讚譽的電視演員來為這場宣傳活動代言拍攝。

reviewWords.mnemonic: act (行動、表演) + -or (人) ＝ 廣告演員 (commercial actor)。

example.en: We are glad to inform you that your application for commercial credit financing has been approved.
example.zh: 我們非常高興且榮幸地通知您，您所申請的商業信用融資案已獲正式核准。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信常見禮貌開頭句型：We are glad to inform you that... (我們很高興通知您...)。

example.en: Warehouse dispatch staff use heavy-duty packaging tape to seal outbound cargo boxes securely.
example.zh: 倉儲出貨人員使用高強度的包裝專用膠帶將出境貨物紙箱妥善封緊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公耗材與物流包裝：packaging tape (包裝膠帶)、tape measure (捲尺)。

meaning: 鑒於(法律合約開頭前言)

example.en: Sales in North America increased by eight percent, whereas European branch revenues remained flat.
example.zh: 北美市場的銷售額成長了百分之八，反之歐洲分公司的營收則維持持平。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀與合約必考對比連接詞：whereas = while (然而、反之)。

example.en: Our customer support agents are always ready to assist users with technical software issues.
example.zh: 我們的客戶支援專員隨時準備好協助使用者解決軟體技術問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業承諾常見頻率副詞，表示持續不變的優質服務態度。

example.en: Securing this overseas government contract was a big milestone for our growing business.
example.zh: 拿下這筆海外政府合約是我們成長中企業的一個重大里程碑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 形容商機或規模常用：big opportunity (大好良機)。

example.en: The committee agreed to set a firm deadline for the submission of all design bids.
example.zh: 委員會同意為所有設計競標文件的繳交設定嚴格的最後期限。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 極高頻職場片語：set a deadline (設定截止日期)、set up (架設/創立)。

example.en: The government launched an initiative to provide low-interest loans to small businesses.
example.zh: 政府推出了一項向小型企業提供低利貸款的輔導方案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業分類常見名詞：small business (中小型企業)。

example.en: A recent market study shows that consumers prefer eco-friendly packaging for cosmetics.
example.zh: 最近一項市場研究顯示，消費者偏好化妝品採用環保包裝。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益報告常客：market study (市場研究)、conduct a study (進行研究)。

example.en: All factory operators must strictly follow the safety instructions displayed on the bulletin board.
example.zh: 所有工廠操作人員皆必須嚴格遵守公告欄上所張貼的安全守則。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 守規矩必備動詞：follow the guidelines / follow the rules (遵守規範)。

example.en: The keynote presentation is scheduled to begin promptly at nine o'clock in the morning.
example.zh: 主旨演講預定於上午九點整準時開始。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議活動開場動詞：begin promptly at (在...準時開始)。

example.en: The vice president will announce an important policy change during today's press conference.
example.zh: 副總裁將在今日的記者會上宣布一項重大的政策變動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 重要性說明標準詞：play an important role in (扮演要角)。
